title: UNIT 1 What's in the Room
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

What's in the room?
There is a table, a sofa and a TV.
Is there a bookshelf?
Yes, there is. It's near the window.

LET'S CHANT
Table, sofa, TV, bookshelf.
What's in the room? Let me tell.
Lamp, clock, picture, vase.
Let's find them in this place!

LET'S PLAY
Describe your room.

There is a bed in my room.
There is a desk near the window.
There is a lamp on the desk.
My room is nice and clean.

LET'S TRY
Listen and draw.

Draw a table in the room.
Draw a sofa beside the table.
Draw a TV on the table.
Draw a bookshelf near the door.
subject: 英语
translation:
第一单元 房间里有什么

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

房间里有什么？
有一张桌子，一张沙发和一台电视。
有书架吗？
有的。它在窗户旁边。

一起来吟唱
桌子，沙发，电视，书架。
房间里有什么？让我告诉你。
台灯，钟，画，花瓶。
让我们在这个地方找到它们！

一起玩一玩
描述你的房间。

我的房间里有一张床。
窗户旁边有一张书桌。
书桌上有一盏台灯。
我的房间又漂亮又整洁。

一起来试试
听录音，画一画。

在房间里画一张桌子。
在桌子旁边画一张沙发。
在桌子上画一台电视。
在门旁边画一个书架。

title: UNIT 2 Daily Life
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

What time do you get up?
I get up at seven o'clock.
What time do you go to school?
I go to school at eight o'clock.

LET'S CHANT
Get up, get up, at seven o'clock.
Go to school, go to school, at eight o'clock.
Have lunch, have lunch, at twelve o'clock.
Go to bed, go to bed, at nine o'clock.

LET'S PLAY
Daily schedule.

I get up at 7:00.
I have breakfast at 7:30.
I go to school at 8:00.
I go home at 4:30.

LET'S TRY
Listen and write the time.

I get up at _____ .
I have breakfast at _____ .
I go to school at _____ .
I go home at _____ .
subject: 英语
translation:
第二单元 日常生活

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

你几点起床？
我七点起床。
你几点上学？
我八点上学。

一起来吟唱
起床，起床，七点钟。
上学，上学，八点钟。
吃午饭，吃午饭，十二点钟。
睡觉，睡觉，九点钟。

一起玩一玩
日常作息表。

我7:00起床。
我7:30吃早餐。
我8:00上学。
我4:30回家。

一起来试试
听录音，写时间。

我_____起床。
我_____吃早餐。
我_____上学。
我_____回家。

title: UNIT 3 Let's Make a Cake
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

Let's make a cake!
Great! What do we need?
We need some flour, eggs and sugar.
Let's start!

LET'S CHANT
Flour and eggs, sugar and butter.
Mix them together, mix them together.
Bake the cake, bake the cake.
A delicious cake we will make!

LET'S PLAY
Cooking show.

First, put some flour in a bowl.
Then, add two eggs.
Next, add some sugar.
Finally, mix them well.

LET'S TRY
Listen and number the steps.

Add the eggs.
Mix the ingredients.
Put the mixture in the oven.
Bake for 30 minutes.
subject: 英语
translation:
第三单元 一起做蛋糕

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

我们一起做蛋糕吧！
太棒了！我们需要什么？
我们需要一些面粉、鸡蛋和糖。
我们开始吧！

一起来吟唱
面粉和鸡蛋，糖和黄油。
把它们混合在一起，混合在一起。
烤蛋糕，烤蛋糕。
我们要做一个美味的蛋糕！

一起玩一玩
烹饪秀。

首先，在碗里放一些面粉。
然后，加入两个鸡蛋。
接下来，加入一些糖。
最后，充分搅拌。

一起来试试
听录音，给步骤编号。

加入鸡蛋。
混合材料。
把混合物放进烤箱。
烤30分钟。

title: UNIT 4 Let's Go Outing
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

Let's go on an outing.
Good idea! Where shall we go?
Let's go to the park.
What can we do there?
We can have a picnic.

LET'S CHANT
Going on an outing, going on an outing.
To the park, to the park.
Having a picnic, having a picnic.
What a lovely day!

LET'S PLAY
Make an outing plan.

We'll go to the park on Sunday.
We'll take some food and drinks.
We'll play games there.
We'll have a great time!

LET'S TRY
Listen and tick.

We'll go to the park.
We'll have a picnic.
We'll fly a kite.
We'll play football.
subject: 英语
translation:
第四单元 一起去郊游

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

我们去郊游吧！
好主意！我们去哪里？
我们去公园吧。
我们在那里可以做什么？
我们可以野餐。

一起来吟唱
去郊游，去郊游。
去公园，去公园。
野餐，野餐。
多美好的一天啊！

一起玩一玩
制定郊游计划。

我们星期天去公园。
我们会带一些食物和饮料。
我们会在那里玩游戏。
我们会玩得很开心！

一起来试试
听录音，打勾。

我们去公园。
我们野餐。
我们放风筝。
我们踢足球。

title: UNIT 5 My Teacher
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

Who is your favourite teacher?
My favourite teacher is Ms Li.
What does she teach?
She teaches English.

LET'S CHANT
My teacher, my teacher,
she teaches English.
My teacher, my teacher,
she is kind and nice.
My teacher, my teacher,
I love her very much.

LET'S PLAY
Introduce your teacher.

This is Mr Wang.
He teaches maths.
He is tall and funny.
I like his class.

LET'S TRY
Listen and match.

Ms Li teaches English.
Mr Wang teaches maths.
Miss Chen teaches Chinese.
Mr Zhang teaches PE.
subject: 英语
translation:
第五单元 我的老师

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

谁是你最喜欢的老师？
我最喜欢的老师是李老师。
她教什么？
她教英语。

一起来吟唱
我的老师，我的老师，
她教英语。
我的老师，我的老师，
她很和蔼。
我的老师，我的老师，
我非常爱她。

一起玩一玩
介绍你的老师。

这是王老师。
他教数学。
他很高，很风趣。
我喜欢他的课。

一起来试试
听录音，连一连。

李老师教英语。
王老师教数学。
陈老师教语文。
张老师教体育。

title: UNIT 6 Let's Celebrate
content:
LET'S TALK
Listen and say.

Let's celebrate the festival!
What festival is it?
It's the Mid-Autumn Festival.
We eat mooncakes.
We watch the moon.

LET'S CHANT
Mooncakes, mooncakes, round and sweet.
Lanterns, lanterns, bright and neat.
Dragon boat, dragon boat, fast and strong.
Festivals, festivals, all year long!

LET'S PLAY
Festival quiz.

What festival is in January?
It's New Year's Day.
What festival is in October?
It's National Day.

LET'S TRY
Listen and match.

Eat mooncakes — Mid-Autumn Festival.
Dragon boat race — Dragon Boat Festival.
Dumplings — Spring Festival.
Watch fireworks — New Year's Eve.
subject: 英语
translation:
第六单元 一起庆祝

一起来聊一聊
听录音，说一说。

我们庆祝节日吧！
什么节日？
是中秋节。
我们吃月饼。
我们赏月。

一起来吟唱
月饼，月饼，又圆又甜。
灯笼，灯笼，又亮又美。
龙舟，龙舟，又快又猛。
节日，节日，一年到！

一起玩一玩
节日猜谜。

一月份是什么节日？
是元旦。
十月份是什么节日？
是国庆节。

一起来试试
听录音，连一连。

吃月饼——中秋节
赛龙舟——端午节
饺子——春节
看烟花——除夕

title: REVISION
content:
REVIEW THE UNITS

What's in the room?
There is a table and a sofa.

What time do you get up?
I get up at seven.

Let's make a cake.
We need flour and eggs.

Let's go on an outing.
Let's go to the park.

Who is your favourite teacher?
Ms Li is my favourite.

Let's celebrate!
Happy Mid-Autumn Festival!
subject: 英语
translation:
复习

房间里有什么？
有一张桌子和一张沙发。

你几点起床？
我七点起床。

一起做蛋糕。
我们需要面粉和鸡蛋。

一起去郊游。
我们去公园。

谁是你最喜欢的老师？
李老师是我最喜欢的。

一起庆祝！
中秋节快乐！
